RSYSTEMS.about: R Systems International Limited, a digital product engineering company, designs and builds chip-to-cloud software products and platforms in Europe, the United States, and internationally. It provides information technology and business process outsourcing services. It also offers modernization solutions, such as legacy system and cloud modernization, hyper automation and managed services, and data and AI; and Cloud and DevOps solutions, including cloud migration and modernization, DevSecOps, CloudOps, FinOps, IoT, and AWS well-architected services; and chaos engineering integrated disaster recovery (DRaaS) models. In addition, it provides digital product engineering solutions that include cloud and DevOps, data and AI, automation and digital Ops, quality engineering, and mobile experience design; data and AI services comprising data strategy and architecture, data stack modernization, generative AI, business intelligence and data visualization, data product development, AI and ML, MLOps, and agentic AI; and automation and No-Code solutions. Further, the company offers embedded firmware services, including low level embedded system development and bottom layer, system software, middleware, and application engineering services, and pre and post silicon verification and validation; quality engineering services comprising comprehensive system, API and backend, and user acceptance testing, specialized testing protocols, test automation and optimization, performance testing excellence, and TOP testing suite; and mobile experience design services. Additionally, it provides enterprise packaged software and iPaaS services, such as advisory consulting, implementation and customization, cloud migration, upgrades, data migration and integration, analytics and reporting, and maintenance, support, and managed services. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Greater Noida, India. R Systems International Limited is a subsidiary of BCP Asia II Topco II Pte. Ltd.

RUBYMILLS.about: The Ruby Mills Limited engages in the manufacture of textile products in India. The company operates in two segments, Textiles, and Real Estate and Related. It offers pure and blended fabrics, including cotton, polyester, viscose, modal, lyocell, linen, Bemberg, ramie, rayon, Lycra, and their blends under the Ruby, Lukas, Hitline, and Label R brand names; basic, LDPE, and HDPE micro dot fusible and non-fusible interlining products, as well as interlining pre-cuts and fragranced interlining products; and ready-to-wears garments, such as uniforms for healthcare institutions, corporates, educational institutions, and defence forces, as well as workwear and fashion apparels. It also engages in the business of renewable power generation; and owning, operating and maintaining water treatment plants. The company is also involved in the development of real estate properties. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1917 and is based in Mumbai, India.

RUBICON.about: Rubicon Research Limited operates as a specialty pharmaceutical company in India, the United States, and internationally. The company develops products in the areas of analgesics/pain management, cardiovascular system, central nervous system, hypokalemia, skeletal muscle relaxants, nicotine replacement therapy, gastrointestinal, metabolic, and immunosuppressant. Its primary proprietary technologies for drug delivery comprising RubiReten, a gastro-retentive system for drugs with poor solubility and a limited window of absorption, as well as RubiSRL for the formulation of sustained release liquids using a combination of ion exchange and membrane diffusion controlled-release technologies. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

RUCHIRA.about: Ruchira Papers Limited manufactures and markets kraft paper, and writing and printing paper products in India and internationally. The company offers white writing and printing papers used for fabrication of spiral notebooks and writing materials; and colored papers used in the fabrication of spiral notebooks, wedding cards, disposable cups and bowls, shade cards, children's colouring books, and bill books; and kraft paper used for making corrugated boxes/cartons, carry bags, burger boxes, and other packaging requirements. It sells its products under Ruchira, Sitara, Kora, Mogra, Gehua, Mela, Baadal, Leher, Pahari, Rozaana, Tarang, Maati, Khadi, Chandan, Kansa, and Neroli brands. Ruchira Papers Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Yamuna Nagar, India.

It also exports its products. Rushil Décor Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

RUPA.about: Rupa & Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, sells, and distributes hosiery products in knitted undergarments, casual wears, and thermal wears for men, women, and kids in India and internationally. The company offers athleisure products, including loungers, joggers, gym vests, and t-shirts; winter wears, such as sweatshirts, upper and lower thermals, hoodies, and jackets; inner wears comprising briefs, drawers, trunks, boxers, vests, bras, panties, camisoles, and shapewears; outer wears, which include barmudas, lowers, capris, shorts, leggings, t-shirts, tank tops, night wears, co-ord sets, and infant wears; and accessories, such as socks, towels, handkerchiefs, and rainsuits. It also generates power through windmill; and provides contract manufacturing services. The company sells its products under the Frontline, Macroman M-series, Macrowoman W-series, Femmora, Torrido, Thermocot, Colors, Bumchums, Macroman Original, Peek-A-Boo, Footline, Rupa Rainsuit, Jon, Softline, Euro, and Zenzi brand names through traditional retail, modern trade, exclusive and multi-brand outlets, and digital and quick commerce. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in Kolkata, India.
